title.zh-CN: 多处骨痛与跛行 · 11岁5个月女孩
title.en: Bone pain in several places and a limp · girl aged 11 years 5 months

summary.zh-CN: 一名11岁女孩的疼痛从双膝开始，九个月来蔓延到腰背、肋骨和髋部，近四个月走路跛行、人也瘦了，收入儿科病房。
summary.en: An 11-year-old girl whose pain began in both knees nine months ago and has spread to her back, ribs and hip is admitted to the children's ward with a four-month limp and weight loss.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例报告改写。患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容：年龄和性别；骨痛从双膝开始、九个月来累及腰背、肋骨和髋部；四个月跛行、下蹲时左髋痛；消瘦；无烦渴、多饮、多尿；入院查体（躯干和骨盆左倾、跛行、骶尾部压痛、左侧4字试验阳性、局部无红热破溃、四肢肌力、肌张力和反射正常）；骨骼影像；血常规、血沉和C反应蛋白；髂骨活检的病理和免疫组化及报告诊断；家长拒绝进一步治疗。这些事实尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以病程长短表示。陪同家长的具体身份、对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分、教学要点和医护人物是教学设计；没有记录的内容（生命体征、体重、影像方法和日期、血涂片、骨髓、其他免疫组化标记、培养、BRAF等分子检测、全身分期、任何治疗、家长拒绝的理由和之后的结局）保持未知。保留的不一致：1.0.0版中文记作“黄色肉芽组织”，英文记作“granulomatous tissue”（肉芽肿性组织），两种读法都保留；左侧体征（下蹲左髋痛、左侧4字试验阳性）与记录的右髂骨病变侧别不同，活检侧别没有记录。
notes.en: Adapted from one published case report. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: age and sex; bone pain that began in both knees and over nine months reached the back, ribs and hip; a four-month limp with left hip pain on squatting; weight loss; no excessive thirst, drinking or urination; the admission examination (trunk and pelvis tilted to the left, limp, sacrococcygeal tenderness, positive left FABER test, no local redness, warmth or skin breakdown, normal limb power, tone and reflexes); the skeletal imaging; the blood count, ESR and CRP; the histology and immunohistochemistry of the iliac biopsy with the report's diagnosis; and the family's refusal of further treatment. They have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are given as durations. Which parent accompanies her, the dialogue, phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; what the case does not record (vital signs, weight, the imaging method and dates, a blood film, marrow, other immunostains, cultures, BRAF or other molecular tests, whole-body staging, any treatment, the family's reasons and any later outcome) stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: 1.0.0 reads 黄色肉芽组织 (yellow granulation tissue) in Chinese but 'granulomatous tissue' in English, and both readings are kept; the left-sided signs (left hip pain on squatting, positive left FABER test) sit beside a recorded right iliac lesion, and the side of the biopsy is not recorded.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别使儿童骨痛不能按生长痛处理的危险信号——跛行、消瘦、脊柱和肋骨疼痛、局部骨压痛和炎症指标升高——并按NICE NG12（2015年发布，2026年更新）立即安排血常规、血涂片和疼痛部位的影像检查。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the red flags that take a child's bone pain beyond growing pains — a limp, weight loss, pain in the spine and ribs, focal bony tenderness and raised inflammatory markers — and arrange a blood count, a film and imaging of the painful sites at once (NICE NG12, 2015, updated 2026).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为伴椎体扁平的儿童多部位骨病变制定确诊计划：排除白血病，选最安全可达的病灶活检，标本分送病理、免疫组化、分子检测和培养，取样之前不用糖皮质激素或含激素的化疗。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan the diagnosis of bone lesions at several levels with flattened vertebrae in a child: exclude leukaemia, biopsy the safest accessible lesion for histology, immunohistochemistry, molecular tests and culture, and give no corticosteroid or steroid-containing chemotherapy before the samples are taken.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把CD68阳性、CD1a和S100阴性的泡沫样组织细胞判读为非朗格汉斯细胞（黄色肉芽肿家族）组织细胞病，与朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症、Rosai–Dorfman病和慢性骨髓炎相鉴别，并说明为什么Erdheim–Chester病要结合临床和影像诊断（WHO第5版，2022；组织细胞学会修订分类，2016）。
learningOutcomes.en: Read CD68-positive foamy histiocytes that are CD1a- and S100-negative as a non-Langerhans (xanthogranuloma-family) histiocytosis, tell it from Langerhans cell histiocytosis, Rosai–Dorfman disease and chronic osteomyelitis, and explain why Erdheim–Chester disease is diagnosed with the clinical and radiological picture (WHO 5th edition, 2022; Histiocyte Society revised classification, 2016).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按2020年ECD国际共识在治疗前完成评估：活检组织的BRAF V600E和MAPK通路检测、包括下肢的全身FDG PET-CT、脑和垂体MRI、心脏和内分泌评估，并转到有经验的组织细胞病中心。
learningOutcomes.en: Complete the pre-treatment work-up the 2020 international ECD consensus sets out: BRAF V600E and MAPK-pathway testing of the biopsy, whole-body FDG PET-CT including the legs, brain and pituitary MRI, cardiac and endocrine assessment, and referral to an experienced histiocytosis centre.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明当前的治疗选择（按突变选择BRAF或MEK抑制剂，或干扰素α等常规治疗；在成人获批，儿童由专科中心决定），以及为什么一篇2011年报告的病程不代表今天的预后。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain today's treatment options — a BRAF or MEK inhibitor chosen by mutation status, or conventional therapy such as interferon-alpha, approved for adults and decided for a child by a specialist centre — and why a 2011 report's course is not today's prognosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用SPIKES（2000）向11岁的孩子和家长说明一种罕见诊断，在家长同意之外争取孩子本人的认同（美国儿科学会，2016），在家长不愿继续治疗时了解原因、提供准确信息并保持随访。
learningOutcomes.en: Share a rare diagnosis with an 11-year-old and her parent using SPIKES (2000), seek her assent alongside the parent's permission (American Academy of Pediatrics, 2016), and when the family is reluctant to treat, explore their reasons, give accurate information and keep follow-up open.

chiefComplaint.en: My bones have hurt in different places for nine months, and I've been limping for the last four

triageNote.zh-CN: 11岁5个月女孩，由家长陪同入住儿科病房。多处骨痛9个月，近4个月跛行，伴消瘦。
triageNote.en: Girl aged 11 years 5 months, admitted to the children's ward with her parent: nine months of bone pain in several places, a limp for the last four months, and weight loss.

personality.zh-CN: 11岁5个月的女孩，九个月来骨头疼，最近走路一瘸一拐；有点拘谨，但能清楚地说出哪里疼、蹲下时怎样。
personality.en: A girl of 11 years 5 months who has had bone pain for nine months and now limps; a little shy, but able to say clearly where it hurts and what squatting does.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子说话简短、口语化，说自己哪里疼、蹲下时怎样；家长讲病程和既往情况，不用医学术语，记不清的就直说记不清。
speechStyle.en: The girl speaks in short, everyday sentences about where it hurts and what squatting does; her parent tells the story of the illness and her background without medical terms, and says so when something has slipped their mind.

openingLine.zh-CN: 我先是两个膝盖疼，后来腰背、肋骨和胯这儿也疼了，已经九个月了。
openingLine.en: First my knees hurt, then my back, my ribs and my hip started hurting too — it's been nine months.

concerns.zh-CN: 疼了这么久，现在走路都瘸了，人也瘦了——是不是骨头里长了不好的东西？
concerns.en: It's gone on so long, she's limping now and she's got thinner — is something bad growing in her bones?

concerns.zh-CN: 我就想不疼了，能好好走路。
concerns.en: I just want it to stop hurting so I can walk properly.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：孩子自己回答哪里疼、怎么疼起来、蹲下时怎样、渴不渴；家长回答病程长短、体重变化、既往情况和家里的事。孩子有点紧张，走路一瘸一拐；家长着急、心疼，但愿意配合。只讲病历里有的事：夜里疼不疼、有没有发烧、以前看过什么病、用过什么药、家族史、生长发育等都没有记录——被问到时如实说说不上来，不要编。活检结果和诊断让医生说；后面阶段的事在病例进入那个阶段之前不要提。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the girl answers where it hurts, how it started, what squatting does and whether she is thirsty; her parent answers how long it has gone on, the weight change, her background and family matters. She is a little nervous and limps; the parent is worried and protective but cooperative. Say only what the notes record: night pain, fevers, earlier care, medicines, family history and growth are not recorded — when asked, say plainly you are not sure, and never invent. The biopsy result and the diagnosis are for the doctors to give; nothing from a later phase is mentioned before the case reaches it.

persona.zh-CN: 陪孩子住院的家长；是爸爸还是妈妈没有记录，不要另加设定。着急、心疼孩子，记得孩子从膝盖疼起、后来走路瘸了、人也瘦了；说不上来的事就直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: The parent staying with her; whether her mother or her father is not recorded, so add nothing. Worried and protective; remembers that the pain began in her knees, that she started limping and that she has got thinner; says plainly what they do not know and draws no medical conclusions.

label.en: Admission: nine months of bone pain

description.zh-CN: 11岁的女孩九个月来多处骨痛，近四个月跛行，收入儿科病房。向她和家长了解病史、给她查体，并开出最初的检查。
description.en: An 11-year-old girl with nine months of bone pain and a four-month limp has been admitted to the children's ward. Take the history from her and her parent, examine her and send the first tests.

label.en: After the biopsy: the pathology report

description.zh-CN: 已经从髂骨病灶取了活检（取材方式和侧别没有记录）。调阅病理和免疫组化结果，判断它说明了什么、还缺什么。
description.en: A biopsy has been taken from the iliac lesion (how, and from which side, is not recorded). Read the histology and immunohistochemistry and decide what they show and what is still missing.

description.en: The histology is back. Plan the work-up that has to come before any treatment, and talk with the girl and her parent about the findings and the next steps.

name.zh-CN: 预约骨病灶活检，标本分送病理、免疫组化、分子检测和培养
name.en: Book a bone-lesion biopsy, with tissue for histology, immunohistochemistry, molecular tests and culture

dose.zh-CN: 与骨科和影像科商定选取最安全可达的病灶和取材方式（影像引导穿刺或切开活检），完成术前准备（凝血、禁食、家长同意和孩子本人的认同）后在麻醉或镇静下取材；新鲜组织送细菌和分枝杆菌培养，固定组织做病理和免疫组化，并留组织做分子检测；取样之前不用糖皮质激素。
dose.en: Agree the safest accessible lesion and the approach with orthopaedics and radiology (image-guided core or open biopsy) and take it under anaesthesia or sedation after the pre-procedure checks (clotting, fasting, the parent's consent and her assent); fresh tissue for bacterial and mycobacterial culture, fixed tissue for histology and immunohistochemistry, and tissue kept for molecular tests; no corticosteroid before the samples are taken.

response.zh-CN: 活检已预约。本病例记录了髂骨活检，但没有记录取材方式和侧别；病理结果在下一阶段可以调阅。

name.zh-CN: 口服泼尼松龙治疗骨痛和血沉升高
name.en: Oral prednisolone for her bone pain and raised ESR

dose.zh-CN: 泼尼松龙1–2 mg/kg/天口服（每天不超过60 mg）。
dose.en: Prednisolone 1–2 mg/kg/day by mouth (no more than 60 mg a day).

harm.zh-CN: 活检和骨髓等诊断标本取得之前用糖皮质激素，可能让白血病、淋巴瘤或朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症部分缓解，使活检无法确诊，还可能诱发肿瘤溶解。英国儿童癌症与白血病组织（CCLG）给专业人员的指引明确：怀疑急性淋巴细胞白血病或非霍奇金淋巴瘤时，转诊确诊之前不能用激素；儿童椎体扁平最常见的原因LCH也要靠病变组织病理确诊（Euro Histio Net儿童LCH指南，2013）。先取样，再决定治疗。
harm.en: A corticosteroid before the biopsy and marrow samples can partly treat leukaemia, lymphoma or Langerhans cell histiocytosis, leaving the biopsy unable to give a diagnosis, and can set off tumour lysis. The UK Children's Cancer and Leukaemia Group's guidance for professionals is plain: when acute lymphoblastic leukaemia or non-Hodgkin lymphoma is possible, no corticosteroid before referral; and LCH, the commonest cause of vertebra plana in children, is diagnosed on lesional histology (Euro Histio Net paediatric LCH guideline, 2013). Take the samples first, then decide on treatment.

response.zh-CN: 已开始泼尼松龙。本病例没有记录用过糖皮质激素；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Prednisolone started. This case does not record any corticosteroid; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 按LCH方案开始长春碱加泼尼松龙
name.en: Start vinblastine with prednisolone on the LCH protocol

dose.zh-CN: 长春碱6 mg/m²静脉推注，每周1次；泼尼松龙40 mg/m²/天口服。
dose.en: Vinblastine 6 mg/m² IV once a week with prednisolone 40 mg/m²/day by mouth.

harm.zh-CN: 椎体扁平不等于朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症：白血病、淋巴瘤、感染和其他组织细胞病都能造成椎体扁平。Euro Histio Net儿童LCH指南（Haupt等，2013）以病变组织的病理和免疫组化（CD1a、langerin）确诊；取样之前用含激素的化疗，会掩盖诊断、带来不必要的毒性，还可能让一个不是LCH的病接受错误的治疗。
harm.en: Flattened vertebrae do not make Langerhans cell histiocytosis: leukaemia, lymphoma, infection and other histiocytoses can all flatten a vertebra. The Euro Histio Net paediatric LCH guideline (Haupt et al., 2013) bases the diagnosis on lesional histology and immunohistochemistry (CD1a, langerin); steroid-containing chemotherapy before the samples masks the diagnosis, adds avoidable toxicity and may treat a disease that is not LCH with the wrong regimen.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何化疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no chemotherapy; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 经验性四联抗结核治疗

dose.zh-CN: 异烟肼、利福平、吡嗪酰胺和乙胺丁醇，按体重分段剂量口服。
dose.en: Isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol by mouth in weight-banded doses.

harm.zh-CN: 脊柱结核确实要考虑，但本病例没有任何结核接触史、病原学或病理证据。经验性治疗意味着至少6个月的四联用药（有肝毒性），在活检前开始还会降低分枝杆菌培养的阳性率、拖延真正的诊断。应在活检时送组织做分枝杆菌培养和分子检测；WHO儿童和青少年结核病指南（模块5，2022）把病原学检查纳入诊断流程。
harm.en: Spinal tuberculosis belongs in the differential, but nothing in this case — no contact, microbiology or histology — supports it. Empirical treatment commits her to at least six months of four potentially hepatotoxic drugs, and started before the biopsy it lowers the yield of mycobacterial culture and delays the real diagnosis. Send biopsy tissue for mycobacterial culture and a molecular test instead; WHO's guidance on TB in children and adolescents (Module 5, 2022) builds bacteriological testing into the diagnostic work-up.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录抗结核治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no antituberculosis treatment; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 按生长痛解释，出院门诊随访
name.en: Explain it as growing pains and discharge to clinic follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 向家长解释为生长痛，按需止痛，出院后门诊随访。
dose.en: Explain growing pains to the family, give analgesia as needed and review her in clinic after discharge.

harm.zh-CN: 生长痛不会引起跛行、消瘦、骨盆倾斜或局部骨压痛，也不累及脊柱和肋骨。NICE NG12（2015年发布，2026年更新）对儿童持续或不明原因的骨痛要求48小时内查血常规（排查白血病），对不明原因的骨痛考虑48小时内拍X线（排查骨肉瘤）；九个月的骨痛伴跛行和消瘦需要现在就在院内完成检查。
harm.en: Growing pains do not cause a limp, weight loss, a pelvic tilt or focal bony tenderness, and they do not involve the spine or ribs. NICE NG12 (2015, updated 2026) asks for a full blood count within 48 hours for persistent or unexplained bone pain in a child (leukaemia) and considers an X-ray within 48 hours for unexplained bone pain (bone sarcoma); nine months of pain with a limp and weight loss needs the work-up now, in hospital.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有这样处理（她已收住儿科病房）；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case did not do this (she was admitted to the children's ward); it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 现在开始维莫非尼（BRAF抑制剂）

dose.zh-CN: 口服，每天2次；剂量由组织细胞病专科确定。
dose.en: By mouth twice daily; the dose is set by the histiocytosis team.

harm.zh-CN: 本病例没有任何BRAF检测结果。2020年ECD国际共识把BRAF抑制剂用于证实携带BRAF V600E的患者；在BRAF野生型细胞中，这类药可反常激活MAPK通路。美国FDA 2017年批准维莫非尼用于BRAF V600突变的成人ECD，儿童使用属超说明书用药，应由专科中心在明确突变和分期之后决定。
harm.en: No BRAF result exists in this case. The 2020 international ECD consensus uses BRAF inhibitors for disease shown to carry BRAF V600E; in BRAF-wild-type cells these drugs can paradoxically activate MAPK signalling. The FDA approved vemurafenib in 2017 for adults with BRAF-V600-mutant ECD; in a child it is off-label and belongs to a specialist centre once the mutation and the stage are known.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录任何靶向治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no targeted therapy; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 和孩子及家长一起谈病情和计划
name.en: Meet the girl and her parent together to explain the findings and the plan

dose.zh-CN: 安静的房间，上级医生和护士在场；先问她们已经知道什么、想知道多少；用孩子听得懂的话说明，留出时间提问，会后记录。
dose.en: A quiet room with the senior doctor and the nurse; first ask what they already know and how much they want to know; explain in words she can follow, leave time for questions and write it up afterwards.

response.zh-CN: 家庭谈话已安排。本病例没有记录与孩子和家长沟通的内容；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The family meeting is arranged. This case does not record what was said to the girl or her parent; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 给家长书面随访计划和联系人
name.en: Give the family a written follow-up plan with a named contact

dose.zh-CN: 写明复诊时间、联系人和电话、需要马上回来的情况（腿没劲或发麻、大小便控制不住、特别口渴尿多），并说明随时可以重新讨论治疗或寻求第二意见。
dose.en: Write down the review date, a named contact and number, the warning signs that need an immediate return (leg weakness or numbness, loss of bladder or bowel control, heavy thirst and urine), and that treatment can be revisited or a second opinion sought at any time.

response.zh-CN: 书面随访计划已交给家长。本病例没有记录之后的随访；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The written follow-up plan is with the family. This case does not record any later follow-up; it does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 听她和家长讲清这九个月
title.en: Hear the nine-month story from her and her parent

hint.zh-CN: 疼痛从哪里开始、后来到了哪里？对走路和体重有什么影响？儿童骨痛时，哪些伴随症状最让你担心？
hint.en: Where did the pain start and where has it gone since? What has it done to her walking and her weight? In a child with bone pain, which other symptoms would worry you most?

guidance.zh-CN: 到她床边，向她和家长了解病史。
guidance.en: Go to her bedside and take the history from her and her parent.

title.zh-CN: 检查她的姿势、步态、骨盆、髋和四肢
title.en: Examine her posture, gait, pelvis, hips and limbs

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能区分关节、骨头还是神经的问题？在她下地走动之前，哪一项检查必须先做？
hint.en: Which signs separate a joint, a bone and a nerve problem — and which check must come before she is up and about?

title.zh-CN: 读懂最初的检查，安排确诊
title.en: Make sense of the first results and arrange the diagnosis

hint.zh-CN: 血常规和炎症指标能排除什么、不能排除什么？这些骨病变是什么分布？在动手治疗之前，你需要先拿到什么？
hint.en: What can the blood count and inflammatory markers rule out, and what can't they? What pattern do the bone lesions make, and what do you need in hand before any treatment?

guidance.zh-CN: 开出最初的检查，在病历终端或床旁调阅；在会诊板作答决策1和决策2，然后落实决策2的计划。
guidance.en: Send the first tests and read them at a records terminal or the bedside; answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board, then put the decision 2 plan into action.

hint.zh-CN: 哪些标记会指向一种病，哪些会指向另一种？只凭这份活检，还有什么定不下来？
hint.en: Which markers would point one way, and which the other? What can this biopsy alone not settle?

guidance.zh-CN: 活检之后：调阅病理和免疫组化结果，作答决策3。
guidance.en: After the biopsy: read the histology and immunohistochemistry and answer decision 3.

title.zh-CN: 治疗前先把该查的查全
title.en: Complete the work-up that must come before treatment

hint.zh-CN: 哪项检查决定靶向药能不能用？这种病可能在没有症状时累及哪些器官？
hint.en: Which test decides whether a targeted drug could work, and which organs could be involved without symptoms?

guidance.zh-CN: 作答决策4，开出治疗前需要的检查，并联系相关专科。
guidance.en: Answer decision 4, order the work-up that must come before treatment and involve the teams it needs.

title.zh-CN: 和孩子及家长谈，回顾结局
title.en: Talk with her and her parent, then review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 她们已经知道了什么、最看重什么？怎样让一个11岁的孩子参与关于她自己治疗的决定？
hint.en: What do they already know, and what matters most to them? How will you involve an 11-year-old in a decision about her own treatment?

guidance.zh-CN: 听听家长和孩子的想法，安排家庭谈话，作答决策5，最后调阅转归记录。
guidance.en: Hear what the parent and the girl think, hold the family meeting, answer decision 5, then read the outcome record.

prompt.zh-CN: 11岁5个月的女孩，疼痛从双膝开始，九个月来扩展到腰背、肋骨和髋部；近四个月跛行，蹲下时左髋痛，人也瘦了。查体：躯干和骨盆左倾、跛行，骶尾部压痛，左侧4字试验阳性，局部无红热破溃，四肢肌力、肌张力和反射正常。你怎样看待这种疼痛，第一步做什么？
prompt.en: A girl of 11 years 5 months has pain that began in both knees and over nine months has spread to her back, ribs and hip; for four months she has limped, her left hip hurts when she squats, and she has lost weight. She stands with her trunk and pelvis tilted to the left and limps; the sacrococcygeal region is tender and the left FABER test positive, with no local redness, warmth or broken skin and normal limb power, tone and reflexes. How do you read this pain, and what do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清疼痛的经过、跛行、下蹲时的疼痛和体重变化，再观察她的姿势和步态、按压骶尾部、做4字试验、查看局部皮肤并检查四肢神经。
need.en: First take the story of the pain, the limp, the pain on squatting and her weight, then look at her posture and gait, press over the sacrum, do a FABER test, check the skin over the painful areas and test her limb neurology.

text.zh-CN: 这不是生长痛或劳损：多处骨痛伴跛行和消瘦是危险信号，当天查血常规加血涂片、血沉和C反应蛋白，并对疼痛部位做影像检查
text.en: Not growing pains or strain: bone pain in several places with a limp and weight loss is a red flag — same-day blood count with a film, ESR and CRP, and imaging of the painful sites

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。生长痛是排除性诊断，不会引起跛行、消瘦或局部骨压痛，也不累及脊柱和肋骨。NICE NG12（2015年发布，2026年更新）要求对儿童持续或不明原因的骨痛在48小时内查血常规（排查白血病），对不明原因的骨痛考虑在48小时内拍X线（排查骨肉瘤）；她的骨痛已经九个月。
feedback.en: Right. Growing pains are a diagnosis of exclusion and do not cause a limp, weight loss or focal bony tenderness, or involve the spine and ribs. NICE NG12 (2015, updated 2026) asks for a full blood count within 48 hours for persistent or unexplained bone pain in a child (leukaemia) and considers an X-ray within 48 hours for unexplained bone pain (bone sarcoma) — her pain has lasted nine months.

text.zh-CN: 神经系统查体正常、局部也没有红热，最可能是生长痛：向家长解释清楚，按需用止痛药，回家观察，门诊随访，疼痛加重再来复查
text.en: With normal limb neurology and no local redness or warmth, growing pains are the likeliest: explain this to the family, give analgesia as needed, send her home and review her in clinic if it worsens

feedback.zh-CN: 正常的神经系统查体不能排除骨病。生长痛多在傍晚或夜间出现在双下肢，查体正常、不跛行；她的跛行、消瘦、骶尾部压痛以及脊柱和肋骨的疼痛都与之不符。NICE NG12（2015年发布，2026年更新）对儿童持续的骨痛要求尽快查血常规并考虑拍X线，而不是回家观察。
feedback.en: Normal limb neurology does not exclude bone disease. Growing pains come in the evening or at night in both legs, with a normal examination and no limp; her limp, weight loss, sacral tenderness and spinal and rib pain all argue against them. NICE NG12 (2015, updated 2026) asks for an urgent blood count and considers an X-ray for persistent bone pain in a child, not sending her home to wait.

text.zh-CN: 骶尾部压痛和左侧4字试验阳性提示附着点炎相关关节炎：开始规律口服非甾体抗炎药，查HLA-B27，转儿童风湿科门诊
text.en: Sacral tenderness and a positive left FABER test point to enthesitis-related arthritis: start a regular NSAID, check HLA-B27 and refer her to the paediatric rheumatology clinic

feedback.zh-CN: 附着点炎相关关节炎确实可有骶髂部疼痛和4字试验阳性，但它解释不了消瘦以及肋骨和腰背的骨痛。幼年特发性关节炎要在排除其他原因之后才能诊断；NICE NG12（2015年发布，2026年更新）对儿童持续骨痛要求先查血常规和影像，在排除肿瘤和感染之前开始抗炎治疗、只查HLA-B27，会延误诊断。
feedback.en: Enthesitis-related arthritis can cause sacroiliac pain and a positive FABER test, but not weight loss or pain in the ribs and back. Juvenile idiopathic arthritis is diagnosed only once other causes are excluded; NICE NG12 (2015, updated 2026) puts a blood count and imaging first for persistent bone pain in a child, and starting an NSAID with only an HLA-B27 before tumour and infection are ruled out delays the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 骨盆倾斜和下蹲时的髋痛提示姿势性或机械性腰背痛：先做理疗和核心肌群锻炼，6周后再评估
text.en: The pelvic tilt and hip pain on squatting suggest postural or mechanical back pain: start physiotherapy and core exercises, and reassess her in six weeks

feedback.zh-CN: 在儿童，伴消瘦、多处疼痛和跛行的腰背痛要先找到原因，不能先贴上机械性疼痛的标签。NICE NG12（2015年发布，2026年更新）对儿童持续的骨痛要求尽快查血常规并考虑拍X线；6周理疗只会再耽误时间。
feedback.en: In a child, back pain with weight loss, pain in several places and a limp needs a cause found before it is called mechanical. NICE NG12 (2015, updated 2026) asks for an urgent blood count and considers an X-ray for persistent bone pain in a child; six weeks of physiotherapy only adds delay.

prompt.zh-CN: 她的血红蛋白108 g/L，白细胞7.8×10⁹/L，血小板324×10⁹/L，血沉38 mm/h，C反应蛋白22.8 mg/L。影像：T2、T10椎体扁平，L3、L5、S2低密度改变，右侧髂骨溶骨性病变，髋关节和骶髂关节间隙正常。下一步最恰当的是什么？
prompt.en: Her haemoglobin is 108 g/L, white cells 7.8 × 10⁹/L, platelets 324 × 10⁹/L, ESR 38 mm/h and CRP 22.8 mg/L. Imaging shows flattened T2 and T10 vertebrae, low-density change at L3, L5 and S2 and an osteolytic lesion of the right ilium, with normal hip and sacroiliac joint spaces. What is the best next step?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策1，再调阅血常规、血沉、C反应蛋白和脊柱骨盆影像报告。
need.en: Answer decision 1, then read the blood count, ESR, CRP and the spine and pelvis imaging report.

text.zh-CN: 先看血涂片排除白血病，在同一次麻醉下做骨髓穿刺并取髂骨病灶活检，组织送病理、免疫组化、分子检测和培养；取样之前不用激素
text.en: Exclude leukaemia with a film, then under one anaesthetic take a marrow and biopsy the iliac lesion for histology, immunohistochemistry, molecular tests and culture, with no steroid before the samples

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。儿童多部位骨病变伴椎体扁平，鉴别包括朗格汉斯细胞和其他组织细胞病、白血病和淋巴瘤、感染（含结核）以及慢性非细菌性骨髓炎，只有病变组织能区分。白细胞正常不能排除白血病，所以先看涂片，并在活检的同一次麻醉下做骨髓穿刺。英国儿童癌症与白血病组织（CCLG）的指引要求可能是白血病或淋巴瘤时确诊取样前不用激素，儿童LCH指南（Haupt等，2013）也以病变组织的病理和免疫组化确诊。
feedback.en: Right. Bone lesions at several levels with flattened vertebrae in a child have a differential of Langerhans cell and other histiocytoses, leukaemia and lymphoma, infection including tuberculosis, and chronic non-bacterial osteomyelitis, and only lesional tissue separates them. A normal white count does not exclude leukaemia, hence the film and a marrow under the same anaesthetic as the biopsy. The UK Children's Cancer and Leukaemia Group (CCLG) advises no steroid before the diagnostic samples when leukaemia or lymphoma is possible, and the paediatric LCH guideline (Haupt et al., 2013) rests the diagnosis on lesional histology and immunohistochemistry.

text.zh-CN: 椎体扁平是朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症的典型表现，病变又是多发的：不必再活检，直接按LCH方案用长春碱加泼尼松龙，治疗6周后复查影像看反应
text.en: Vertebra plana is the classic sign of Langerhans cell histiocytosis and the lesions are multifocal: skip the biopsy, start vinblastine with prednisolone on the LCH protocol and re-image after six weeks to judge the response

feedback.zh-CN: 儿童椎体扁平最常见于LCH，但白血病、淋巴瘤、感染和其他组织细胞病也能造成。儿童LCH指南（Haupt等，2013）要求先有病变组织的病理和CD1a、langerin免疫组化确诊；未确诊就用含激素的化疗，会掩盖白血病或淋巴瘤，也可能让一个不是LCH的病接受错误的方案。
feedback.en: In children vertebra plana is most often LCH, but leukaemia, lymphoma, infection and other histiocytoses can cause it too. The paediatric LCH guideline (Haupt et al., 2013) asks for lesional histology with CD1a and langerin immunohistochemistry first; steroid-containing chemotherapy without a diagnosis can mask leukaemia or lymphoma and treat a disease that is not LCH with the wrong regimen.

text.zh-CN: 多个椎体破坏加上血沉和C反应蛋白升高，最可能是脊柱结核：先做结核菌素试验或γ干扰素释放试验，阳性就直接开始四联抗结核治疗，不必再做活检
text.en: Several damaged vertebrae with a raised ESR and CRP make spinal tuberculosis the likeliest cause: do a tuberculin skin test or an IGRA, and if it is positive start four-drug treatment straight away without a biopsy

feedback.zh-CN: 脊柱结核必须考虑，但结核菌素试验或γ干扰素释放试验阳性只说明有结核感染，不能证明骨病变就是结核，阴性也不能排除。多个跳跃的病灶加上髂骨溶骨，需要组织病理和分枝杆菌培养来区分肿瘤、组织细胞病和结核；WHO儿童和青少年结核病指南（模块5，2022）也把病原学检查纳入诊断流程。
feedback.en: Spinal tuberculosis must be considered, but a positive skin test or IGRA shows TB infection, not that the bone lesions are TB, and a negative one does not exclude it. Skip lesions at several levels plus a lytic iliac lesion need histology and mycobacterial culture to tell tumour, histiocytosis and TB apart; WHO's guidance on TB in children and adolescents (Module 5, 2022) builds bacteriological testing into the diagnostic work-up.

text.zh-CN: 血象基本正常、炎症指标轻度升高、关节间隙正常，更像慢性复发性多灶性骨髓炎：先规律用萘普生等非甾体抗炎药，3个月后复查影像，无效再活检
text.en: A near-normal count, mildly raised markers and normal joint spaces fit chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis: start a regular NSAID such as naproxen, re-image in three months and biopsy only if that fails

feedback.zh-CN: 慢性非细菌性骨髓炎是排除性诊断。椎体扁平、消瘦和髂骨溶骨性病变要求先取组织排除肿瘤、组织细胞病和感染，再考虑按慢性骨髓炎试用非甾体抗炎药；NICE NG12（2015年发布，2026年更新）对儿童持续骨痛要求尽快检查，而不是观察三个月。
feedback.en: Chronic non-bacterial osteomyelitis is a diagnosis of exclusion. Flattened vertebrae, weight loss and an osteolytic iliac lesion call for tissue to exclude tumour, histiocytosis and infection before an NSAID trial is considered; NICE NG12 (2015, updated 2026) asks for urgent investigation of persistent bone pain in a child, not three months of watching.

prompt.zh-CN: 髂骨活检：黄色肉芽组织，伴纤维化和泡沫样组织细胞；免疫组化CD68和α1-抗糜蛋白酶阳性，CD1a和S100阴性。这说明什么，还缺什么？
prompt.en: The iliac biopsy shows yellow granulation tissue with fibrosis and foamy histiocytes; CD68 and alpha-1-antichymotrypsin are positive, CD1a and S100 negative. What does this show, and what is still missing?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅髂骨活检的病理和免疫组化结果。
need.en: Read the histology and immunohistochemistry of the iliac biopsy first.

text.zh-CN: 非朗格汉斯细胞（黄色肉芽肿家族）组织细胞病，结合骨病变首先考虑Erdheim–Chester病，还需长骨影像、全身分期和BRAF检测确认
text.en: A non-Langerhans (xanthogranuloma-family) histiocytosis, with these bone lesions Erdheim–Chester disease first; long-bone imaging, whole-body staging and BRAF testing must confirm it

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。泡沫样组织细胞CD68阳性、CD1a和S100阴性，符合非朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞病。WHO造血与淋巴组织肿瘤分类第5版（2022）把Erdheim–Chester病列为组织细胞肿瘤；组织细胞学会2016年修订分类把它与LCH同列于L组，并指出近20%的ECD患者同时有LCH病灶。ECD要结合临床和影像诊断（典型为双下肢长骨对称性骨硬化），所以还缺长骨影像、全身分期和BRAF V600E等分子检测。
feedback.en: Right. CD68-positive foamy histiocytes that are CD1a- and S100-negative fit a non-Langerhans histiocytosis. The WHO 5th edition (2022) classes Erdheim–Chester disease among the histiocytic neoplasms, and the Histiocyte Society's 2016 revision puts it beside LCH in its L group, noting that nearly 20 % of patients with ECD also have LCH lesions. ECD is diagnosed with the clinical and radiological picture (classically symmetric osteosclerosis of the leg long bones), so long-bone imaging, whole-body staging and BRAF V600E testing are still missing.

text.zh-CN: 朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症：CD68阳性的组织细胞加上椎体扁平已足够诊断，CD1a和S100阴性多半是取材不足，按LCH方案开始长春碱加泼尼松龙
text.en: Langerhans cell histiocytosis: CD68-positive histiocytes with vertebra plana are enough, the negative CD1a and S100 most likely reflect a poor sample, and vinblastine with prednisolone on the LCH protocol should start

feedback.zh-CN: LCH细胞的特征是CD1a和langerin（CD207）阳性，通常S100也阳性；CD68在多种组织细胞中都可阳性，不能定性。泡沫样组织细胞为主而CD1a和S100都阴性，正是指向非朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞病的依据（组织细胞学会2016年修订分类）；把它当成取材不足，会让孩子接受不对症的方案。
feedback.en: LCH cells are CD1a- and langerin (CD207)-positive and usually S100-positive; CD68 marks many kinds of histiocyte and decides nothing. A lesion of foamy histiocytes that is negative for both CD1a and S100 is exactly what points away from LCH (Histiocyte Society revised classification, 2016); calling it a poor sample would put her on the wrong regimen.

text.zh-CN: Rosai–Dorfman病：泡沫样组织细胞和纤维化都符合，S100阴性并不影响这个诊断，可以先观察，等症状明显时再用糖皮质激素控制
text.en: Rosai–Dorfman disease: the foamy histiocytes and fibrosis fit, S100 negativity does not count against it, and she can be observed, with corticosteroids if the symptoms become troublesome

feedback.zh-CN: Rosai–Dorfman病的组织细胞S100阳性，常见伸入运动；本例S100阴性，与之不符。组织细胞学会2016年修订分类把Rosai–Dorfman病单列为R组，与泡沫样、CD1a阴性的黄色肉芽肿家族不同；观察等待还会漏掉需要分期的病。
feedback.en: In Rosai–Dorfman disease the histiocytes are S100-positive, often with emperipolesis; S100 is negative here. The Histiocyte Society's 2016 revision places Rosai–Dorfman disease in its own R group, apart from the foamy, CD1a-negative xanthogranuloma family, and watching and waiting would miss a disease that needs staging.

text.zh-CN: 黄色肉芽肿性骨髓炎：泡沫样组织细胞和纤维化是对慢性感染的反应，先静脉用抗生素6周，再复查影像，如果病灶好转就不必再做进一步检查
text.en: Xanthogranulomatous osteomyelitis: the foamy histiocytes and fibrosis are a reaction to chronic infection, so give six weeks of IV antibiotics and re-image, with no further tests if the lesions improve

feedback.zh-CN: 慢性感染确实可以出现泡沫样组织细胞和纤维化，所以活检组织应送培养；但本例没有记录培养或其他病原学结果，而多个椎体和髂骨同时受累更符合组织细胞肿瘤。2020年ECD国际共识要求把病理与临床、影像和BRAF等分子检测结合起来判断，而不是凭形态先用6周抗生素。
feedback.en: Chronic infection can produce foamy histiocytes and fibrosis, which is why the tissue goes for culture; but no culture or other microbiology is recorded here, and lesions in several vertebrae and the ilium at once fit a histiocytic neoplasm better. The 2020 international ECD consensus reads the histology with the clinical picture, the imaging and molecular tests such as BRAF, rather than treating on morphology with six weeks of antibiotics.

prompt.zh-CN: 病理提示非朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞病。在选择任何针对疾病的治疗之前，现在应当做哪些事？（多选）
prompt.en: The biopsy points to a non-Langerhans histiocytosis. Before any disease-directed treatment is chosen, which steps belong in her work-up now? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策3，判读活检结果。
need.en: Answer decision 3 on the biopsy first.

text.zh-CN: 在活检组织上检测BRAF V600E；阴性时再做MAPK通路其他基因的检测
text.en: Test the biopsy tissue for BRAF V600E, and for other MAPK-pathway genes if it is negative

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。2020年ECD国际共识建议所有患者检测BRAF V600E，阴性者做更广的MAPK通路检测；约一半ECD携带BRAF V600E。结果决定选BRAF抑制剂还是MEK抑制剂。
feedback.en: Yes. The 2020 international ECD consensus recommends BRAF V600E testing for every patient and wider MAPK-pathway testing when it is negative; about half of ECD carries BRAF V600E. The result decides between a BRAF inhibitor and a MEK inhibitor.

text.zh-CN: 全身分期：从头顶到足的FDG PET-CT（儿童也可用全身MRI以减少辐射）、脑和垂体增强MRI、心脏影像，必要时加做胸腹盆CT
text.en: Stage the whole body: FDG PET-CT from vertex to toes (or whole-body MRI to spare a child radiation), contrast MRI of the brain and pituitary, cardiac imaging, and chest, abdomen and pelvis CT as needed

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。2020年ECD国际共识建议基线做包括下肢的全身FDG PET-CT、脑部增强MRI和心脏评估（儿科团队也可用全身MRI以减少辐射），因为中枢神经和心血管受累决定预后；分期结果和突变一起决定治疗的选择和紧迫性。
feedback.en: Yes. The 2020 international ECD consensus asks for baseline whole-body FDG PET-CT including the legs, contrast brain MRI and cardiac assessment (a paediatric team may use whole-body MRI to limit radiation), because brain and cardiovascular involvement set the prognosis; the stage and the mutation together decide the choice and urgency of treatment.

text.zh-CN: 即使她没有多饮多尿，也查晨尿和血浆渗透压、血钠和垂体前叶激素
text.en: Even without thirst or heavy urine, check early-morning urine and plasma osmolality, sodium and the anterior pituitary hormones

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。尿崩症和垂体前叶功能减退在ECD和LCH中都可出现，垂体前叶功能减退可以没有症状；她没有多饮多尿，但这不能代替检查。2020年ECD国际共识把内分泌评估列入基线检查。
feedback.en: Yes. Diabetes insipidus and anterior pituitary deficits occur in both ECD and LCH, and pituitary deficits can be silent; her lack of thirst and polyuria does not replace testing. The 2020 international ECD consensus includes an endocrine evaluation in the baseline work-up.

text.zh-CN: 先经验性开始BRAF抑制剂，因为约一半ECD有BRAF V600E突变，分期等用上药以后再做
text.en: Start a BRAF inhibitor empirically, since about half of ECD carries BRAF V600E, and stage her once treatment is under way

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。“约一半”意味着另一半没有这个突变；2020年ECD国际共识只对证实携带BRAF V600E者用BRAF抑制剂，在BRAF野生型细胞中这类药可反常激活MAPK通路。美国FDA 2017年批准维莫非尼用于BRAF V600突变的成人ECD，儿童属超说明书用药。
feedback.en: No. ‘About half’ means the other half lacks the mutation; the 2020 international ECD consensus uses BRAF inhibitors only for proven BRAF V600E, and in BRAF-wild-type cells these drugs can paradoxically activate MAPK signalling. The FDA approved vemurafenib in 2017 for adults with BRAF-V600-mutant ECD; in a child it is off-label.

text.zh-CN: 等结果期间先口服泼尼松龙控制骨痛和炎症，作为过渡治疗
text.en: Bridge with oral prednisolone for the pain and inflammation while the results are awaited

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。糖皮质激素也许能暂时缓解症状，但它不是2020年ECD国际共识规定的针对疾病的治疗（按突变选择的靶向药，或干扰素α等常规治疗），也不能代替分期和分子检测；止痛可以用普通镇痛药。
feedback.en: No. A corticosteroid may ease symptoms for a while, but it is not the disease-directed treatment the 2020 international ECD consensus sets out (targeted drugs chosen by mutation status, or conventional therapy such as interferon-alpha), and it cannot replace staging or molecular testing; ordinary analgesia can manage the pain.

prompt.zh-CN: 病理和下一步计划已经清楚。家长说只知道从胯骨上取了组织化验、听说是一种少见的病，最想知道能不能治、孩子要受多少罪。你怎样和魏予宁及家长谈？
prompt.en: The histology and the plan are clear. Her parent knows only that tissue was taken from her hip bone and that it is something unusual, and most wants to know whether it can be treated and what she would go through. How do you talk with Wei Yuning and her parent?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策4，并问清家长已经知道什么、最想知道什么。
need.en: Answer decision 4, and ask her parent what they already know and most want to know.

text.zh-CN: 和孩子、家长一起谈：先问她们知道什么、想知道多少，用孩子听得懂的话说明这种罕见病、为什么先分期和查基因、现在已有靶向药，坦白不确定之处，听她的想法，约好下次再谈
text.en: Talk with both: ask what they know and want to know, explain the rare disease in words she can follow, why staging and gene tests come first and that targeted drugs now exist, be honest about the uncertainty, hear her view and agree when to talk again

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。SPIKES（Baile等，2000）从了解对方已经知道什么、想知道多少开始，再给信息、回应情绪、共同计划。美国儿科学会（2016）主张按发育水平让孩子参与决策，在家长同意之外取得孩子的认同，11岁的孩子应当参与。ECD的预后取决于受累器官和突变，所以先分期再谈预期；靶向药2017年起已在成人获批。
feedback.en: Right. SPIKES (Baile et al., 2000) starts from what the family knows and wants to know, then gives information, answers emotion and agrees a plan. The American Academy of Pediatrics (2016) asks that children take part in decisions as their development allows, with the child's assent alongside the parent's permission — an 11-year-old should be involved. ECD's outlook depends on the organs involved and the mutation, so staging comes before predictions; targeted drugs have been approved for adults since 2017.

text.zh-CN: 只和家长谈，孩子还小、听了会害怕：把诊断和治疗方案都讲给家长，由家长决定告诉孩子多少，孩子不参加讨论，也不必问她的意见
text.en: Talk to the parent alone because she is young and would be frightened: give the parent the diagnosis and plan, let them decide how much she hears, and keep her out of the discussion without asking her view

feedback.zh-CN: 想保护孩子可以理解，但美国儿科学会（2016）主张按发育水平让儿童参与决策，并在合理时取得孩子的认同；把11岁的孩子排除在外，会让她独自面对身体的变化，也会削弱她对后续检查和治疗的配合。可以先单独和家长谈，再一起用孩子听得懂的话说明（SPIKES，2000）。
feedback.en: Wanting to protect her is understandable, but the American Academy of Pediatrics (2016) asks that children take part in decisions as their development allows and give their assent where reasonable; shutting an 11-year-old out leaves her alone with what is happening to her body and weakens her part in later tests and treatment. Speak with the parent first if they wish, then together in words she can follow (SPIKES, 2000).

text.zh-CN: 坦白告诉家长：这种病很罕见，文献里的治疗效果不好，用药受罪也未必有用，带回家只用止痛药观察也是合理的选择
text.en: Tell the parent frankly that the disease is rare, that published treatment results are poor and that drugs may make her suffer without helping, so taking her home on painkillers is a reasonable choice

feedback.zh-CN: 这是把旧文献的悲观印象当成今天的事实。2020年ECD国际共识和2017年以来陆续获批的BRAF、MEK抑制剂已经改变了治疗前景，她的预后要等分期和分子结果才能判断；用“治疗没用”劝家长回家，会让他们在没有准确信息时作决定（SPIKES，2000）。
feedback.en: This turns old reports' pessimism into today's facts. The 2020 international ECD consensus and the BRAF and MEK inhibitors approved since 2017 have changed the outlook, and her own prognosis waits for staging and the molecular results; steering the family home with ‘treatment does not work’ leaves them deciding without accurate information (SPIKES, 2000).

text.zh-CN: 告诉家长必须马上同意开始靶向治疗，否则孩子很快会瘫痪；如果拒绝，就请他们签字自愿放弃，并上报医务处
text.en: Tell the parent they must agree to targeted treatment at once or she will soon be paralysed, and if they refuse, have them sign a waiver and report it to the hospital administration

feedback.zh-CN: 用“会瘫痪”施压并不诚实：她的四肢神经检查正常，病程还要等分期判断；威胁和签“自愿放弃”文书都不是共同决策。SPIKES（2000）和美国儿科学会（2016）都要求如实说明利弊和不确定性、听取家长和孩子的顾虑；如果家长拒绝明显有益的治疗，应先了解原因、继续沟通，并与上级医生和医院伦理团队讨论。
feedback.en: Pressing with ‘she will be paralysed’ is not honest — her limb neurology is normal and the course waits on staging — and threats or a waiver are not shared decision-making. SPIKES (2000) and the American Academy of Pediatrics (2016) ask for honest benefits, risks and uncertainty and for the parent's and the child's concerns to be heard; if a parent declines clearly beneficial treatment, explore why, keep talking and involve senior colleagues and the hospital's ethics team.

text.zh-CN: 问清疼痛从双膝开始、扩展到腰背、肋骨和髋部的经过，四个月跛行、下蹲时左髋痛、消瘦和有无多饮多尿，并追问夜间痛、发热、下肢无力或大小便障碍和结核接触
text.en: Took the story of the pain from both knees to the back, ribs and hip, the four-month limp, left hip pain on squatting, weight loss and thirst or polyuria, and asked about night pain, fevers, leg weakness or bladder and bowel trouble and TB contact

text.zh-CN: 观察姿势和步态，按压骶尾部，做4字试验，查看疼痛部位皮肤，并检查四肢肌力、肌张力和反射
text.en: Looked at her posture and gait, pressed over the sacrum and coccyx, did a FABER test, checked the skin over the painful areas and tested limb power, tone and reflexes

text.zh-CN: 入院时调阅血常规、血沉、C反应蛋白和脊柱骨盆影像，并送检外周血涂片
text.en: On admission read the blood count, ESR, CRP and the spine and pelvis imaging, and sent a blood film

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即识别出不能按生长痛或机械性疼痛处理的危险信号
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt the red flags that rule out growing pains or mechanical pain

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即为多部位骨病变选择先排除白血病、再取组织的方案，并预约了髂骨病灶活检
text.en: Chose at the first attempt to exclude leukaemia and obtain tissue for the bone lesions at several levels, and booked the iliac biopsy

text.zh-CN: 活检取样之前没有使用糖皮质激素或含激素的LCH化疗
text.en: Gave no corticosteroid and no steroid-containing LCH chemotherapy before the biopsy samples were taken

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把活检判读为非朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞病，并指出确诊还缺哪些证据
text.en: Read the biopsy as a non-Langerhans histiocytosis at the first attempt and named the evidence still missing

text.zh-CN: 选择治疗之前送检活检组织的分子检测，并开出全身PET-CT（或全身MRI）和脑垂体MRI
text.en: Before any treatment choice, sent the biopsy tissue for molecular testing and ordered whole-body PET-CT (or whole-body MRI) and brain and pituitary MRI

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对治疗前的评估内容，并做了心脏超声、渗透压和脊柱MRI检查，请了血液肿瘤科和脊柱外科
text.en: Chose the pre-treatment work-up at the first attempt, ordered the echocardiogram, osmolality and spine MRI, and involved haematology-oncology and the spinal team

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择与孩子和家长共同商量的谈话方式，安排了家庭谈话并给出书面随访计划
text.en: Chose a shared conversation with the girl and her parent at the first attempt, held the family meeting and gave a written follow-up plan

text.zh-CN: 没有按生长痛让她出院，没有经验性抗结核，也没有在没有BRAF结果时用BRAF抑制剂
text.en: Did not discharge her as growing pains, start empirical antituberculosis drugs or give a BRAF inhibitor without a BRAF result

text.zh-CN: 用孩子和家长都能听懂的话说明罕见诊断、治疗前评估和不确定性，争取孩子的认同
text.en: Explained the rare diagnosis, the pre-treatment work-up and the uncertainty in words the girl and her parent could follow, and sought her assent

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（SPIKES，结合Calgary–Cambridge）：安排安静的房间，上级医生和护士在场，孩子和家长都在（家长希望时可先单独谈）；先问她们已经知道什么、想知道多少；用孩子听得懂的话说明：从胯骨取的组织里看到一种少见的“组织细胞”病，叫Erdheim–Chester病，在孩子中很少见；解释为什么还要做基因检测和全身检查（看哪些器官受累、能不能用靶向药），说明靶向药已在成人获批、儿童用药由专科中心决定，预后要等检查结果才能说；坦白不确定之处，不引用旧文献的“治不好”，也不用“会瘫痪”吓唬；问孩子自己的想法和担心，争取她的认同；回应情绪，用回授法确认理解；如果家长倾向不治疗，先了解原因（费用、怕药物副作用、对疗效的印象等），说明随时可以再谈或寻求第二意见，给出书面随访计划和需要马上回来的情况（腿没劲或发麻、大小便控制不住、特别口渴尿多）；不施压、不替家长作决定，并记录谈话。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (SPIKES within Calgary–Cambridge): a quiet room with the senior doctor and the nurse, the girl and her parent both present (the parent first, alone, if they wish); first asks what they know and how much they want to know; explains in words she can follow that the tissue from her hip bone shows an unusual disease of ‘histiocytes’, Erdheim–Chester disease, which is rare in children; explains why gene tests and whole-body scans come next (which organs are involved, and whether a targeted drug could work), that targeted drugs are approved for adults and a specialist centre decides about them for a child, and that the outlook waits for those results; is honest about the uncertainty, without quoting old reports that ‘nothing works’ or frightening them with paralysis; asks the girl for her own view and worries and seeks her assent; responds to emotion and checks understanding by teach-back; if the family leans towards no treatment, explores why (cost, fear of side effects, what they have heard about results), says the door stays open and a second opinion is welcome, and gives a written follow-up plan with the signs that need an immediate return (leg weakness or numbness, loss of bladder or bowel control, heavy thirst and urine); applies no pressure, does not decide for them and documents the conversation.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教、按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“哪些表现让你不再考虑生长痛？”“几个节段的骨病变加上椎体扁平，鉴别诊断有哪些？哪个病灶最适合取活检，标本要送哪些检查？”“确诊之前，哪些看似合理的治疗会掩盖诊断？”“CD1a和S100阴性能排除什么、不能排除什么？还缺哪些证据？”“选择治疗之前必须知道什么？怎样让一个11岁的孩子参与？”说明这是2011年发表的历史病例：本病例没有记录分子检测和全身分期，它的结局不能说明今天的治疗效果。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或结局；生命体征、体重、影像方法和日期、血涂片、骨髓、其他免疫组化标记、培养、BRAF、分期和家长拒绝治疗的理由都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “What made you stop thinking of growing pains?”, “Bone lesions at several levels with flattened vertebrae — what is the differential, which lesion is the best to biopsy, and what must the tissue be sent for?”, “Before the diagnosis, which reasonable-looking treatments could hide it?”, “What do a negative CD1a and S100 rule out, what can't they, and what evidence is still missing?”, “What must you know before choosing a treatment, and how will you involve an 11-year-old?”. Explains that this is a historical case published in 2011: the case records no molecular test or whole-body staging, and its outcome is no measure of treatment today. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early; vital signs, weight, the imaging method and dates, a blood film, marrow, other immunostains, cultures, BRAF, staging and the family's reasons for declining treatment are not recorded — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：11岁5个月女孩，由家长陪同入院；多处骨痛9个月（从双膝开始，后来是腰背、肋骨和髋部），近4个月跛行，伴消瘦。可以协助抽血送检、预约影像（MRI、X线、PET-CT、超声心动图）、联系骨科和影像科安排活检、按医嘱给止痛药、安排家庭谈话。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到入院生命体征、体重或身高时，直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): girl aged 11 years 5 months, admitted with her parent; nine months of bone pain in several places (first both knees, later the back, ribs and hip), a limp for the last four months, and weight loss. Can help with bloods, booking imaging (MRI, X-ray, PET-CT, echocardiography), arranging the biopsy with orthopaedics and radiology, charted analgesia and the family meeting. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly that her admission observations, weight and height are not recorded.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童放射科医生，只解读学员已经看过的影像报告。可以讲：儿童椎体扁平的鉴别（最常见于LCH，也见于白血病、淋巴瘤、感染和其他组织细胞病）；溶骨性和低密度病变的意义；关节间隙正常提示病变在骨而不在关节；脊柱MRI用于评估椎管内软组织和脊髓受压；ECD典型的影像是双下肢长骨骨干和干骺端对称性骨硬化，PET-CT应扫到足部。本病例没有记录影像检查的方法和日期，也没有记录长骨影像或MRI，不要补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric radiologist who interprets only imaging reports the learner has already read. Can explain the differential of vertebra plana in a child (most often LCH, also leukaemia, lymphoma, infection and other histiocytoses); what lytic and low-density lesions mean; why normal joint spaces place the disease in bone rather than joint; spine MRI for soft tissue in the canal and cord compression; and that ECD's classic picture is symmetric osteosclerosis of the diaphyses and metaphyses of the leg long bones, so a PET-CT should run to the feet. The case records neither the imaging method nor its dates, and no long-bone imaging or MRI — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病理科医生，只解读学员已经看过的活检结果。可以讲：LCH细胞表达CD1a和langerin（CD207），通常S100阳性；黄色肉芽肿家族（包括ECD和幼年黄色肉芽肿）的泡沫样组织细胞CD68、CD163和因子XIIIa阳性，CD1a和langerin阴性，S100多为阴性或不定；Rosai–Dorfman病S100阳性、常见伸入运动；α1-抗糜蛋白酶（AACT）是组织细胞标记，不区分类型；BRAF V600E可用免疫组化（VE1）或分子方法检测；“肉芽组织”与“肉芽肿性组织”的区别。本病例只记录了CD68、AACT、CD1a和S100，没有记录CD163、因子XIIIa、langerin、BRAF或培养结果，不要补上。
knowledge.en: Pathologist who interprets only biopsy results the learner has already read. Can explain that LCH cells express CD1a and langerin (CD207) and are usually S100-positive; that the foamy histiocytes of the xanthogranuloma family (including ECD and juvenile xanthogranuloma) are CD68-, CD163- and factor XIIIa-positive, CD1a- and langerin-negative, with variable S100; that Rosai–Dorfman disease is S100-positive, often with emperipolesis; that alpha-1-antichymotrypsin (AACT) marks histiocytes without telling the types apart; that BRAF V600E can be shown by immunohistochemistry (VE1) or molecular methods; and the difference between granulation tissue and granulomatous tissue. The case records only CD68, AACT, CD1a and S100 — no CD163, factor XIIIa, langerin, BRAF or culture result — never supply them.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：以多处骨痛和跛行起病的儿童Erdheim–Chester病
title.en: Debrief: Erdheim–Chester disease in a child presenting with bone pain and a limp

conclusion.zh-CN: 11岁5个月女孩，骨痛从双膝开始，九个月来累及腰背、肋骨和髋部，近四个月跛行、下蹲时左髋痛，伴消瘦，无多饮多尿。查体躯干和骨盆左倾、跛行，骶尾部压痛，左侧4字试验阳性，四肢神经检查正常。血红蛋白108 g/L，白细胞7.8×10⁹/L，血小板324×10⁹/L，血沉38 mm/h，C反应蛋白22.8 mg/L。影像示T2、T10椎体扁平，L3、L5、S2低密度改变，右髂骨溶骨性病变，髋和骶髂关节间隙正常。髂骨活检见泡沫样组织细胞伴纤维化，CD68、AACT阳性，CD1a、S100阴性，报告诊断Erdheim–Chester病。家长拒绝进一步治疗，之后的结局没有记录。现行做法：取样前不用激素，结合影像判读活检，做BRAF V600E和MAPK检测与全身分期（2020年国际共识），在专科中心选择治疗，并让孩子参与决定。
conclusion.en: A girl of 11 years 5 months had nine months of bone pain that began in both knees and spread to her back, ribs and hip, a four-month limp with left hip pain on squatting, and weight loss, without thirst or polyuria. She stood with her trunk and pelvis tilted to the left and limped; the sacrococcygeal region was tender, the left FABER test positive and limb neurology normal. Haemoglobin was 108 g/L, white cells 7.8 × 10⁹/L, platelets 324 × 10⁹/L, ESR 38 mm/h, CRP 22.8 mg/L. Imaging showed flattened T2 and T10, low-density change at L3, L5 and S2 and an osteolytic right iliac lesion. An iliac biopsy showed foamy histiocytes with fibrosis, CD68- and AACT-positive and CD1a- and S100-negative: Erdheim–Chester disease. The family declined further treatment. Today: no steroid before tissue, BRAF/MAPK testing and staging (2020 consensus), shared decisions.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 多处骨痛伴跛行、消瘦和局部体征，单凭病史和查体就足以排除生长痛，应当天查血常规、涂片和疼痛部位影像。
keyReasoning.en: Bone pain in several places with a limp, weight loss and focal signs is not growing pains: the history and examination alone justify same-day bloods, a film and imaging of the painful sites.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 多个节段的骨病变伴椎体扁平，鉴别范围有限——组织细胞病、白血病或淋巴瘤、感染、慢性非细菌性骨髓炎——只有组织能区分；最安全可达的是髂骨病灶。
keyReasoning.en: Bone lesions at several levels with flattened vertebrae have a short list — histiocytosis, leukaemia or lymphoma, infection, chronic non-bacterial osteomyelitis — that only tissue can settle, and the iliac lesion is the safest target.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 最危险的捷径是没有组织就治疗：凭影像就用激素、LCH化疗或抗结核药，会掩盖或错过真正的诊断。
keyReasoning.en: The dangerous shortcut is treatment before tissue: a steroid, LCH chemotherapy or antituberculosis drugs started on the pictures alone can hide or miss the real diagnosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: CD68阳性、CD1a和S100阴性的泡沫样组织细胞指向黄色肉芽肿家族，而不是LCH或Rosai–Dorfman病；ECD还要结合全身临床和影像表现确定。
keyReasoning.en: CD68-positive foamy histiocytes that are CD1a- and S100-negative point to the xanthogranuloma family rather than LCH or Rosai–Dorfman disease; ECD then rests on the whole clinical and radiological picture.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗方案取决于突变和受累器官，所以任何用药之前都要先做BRAF/MAPK检测和全身分期，并由专科中心决定。
keyReasoning.en: The treatment follows the mutation and the organs involved, so BRAF/MAPK testing and whole-body staging come before any drug, decided at a specialist centre.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 家长拒绝继续治疗是一个沟通结局，不是对现代治疗的评价：让孩子参与、说明不确定性，并保持随访的通道。
keyReasoning.en: The family's refusal of further treatment is a communication outcome, not a verdict on modern therapy: involve the child, explain the uncertainty and keep the door open.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2011年发表的单例报告，不能用来比较治疗方法，也不能据此判断儿童ECD的预后。病例事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；本病例没有记录生命体征、影像方法、分子检测、全身分期、任何治疗以及家长拒绝治疗之后的情况，也不模拟任何生理变化。决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据现行指南的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report published in 2011: it cannot compare treatments or set a prognosis for ECD in children. The case facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; the case records no vital signs, imaging method, molecular test, whole-body staging or treatment, and nothing after the family declined treatment, and no physiology is simulated. The decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design based on current guidance and do not change the published course.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 危险信号（NICE NG12，2015年发布，2026年更新）：生长痛是排除性诊断——傍晚或夜间的双下肢疼痛、查体正常、不跛行。本例九个月的多处骨痛（双膝→腰背、肋骨、髋部）、四个月跛行、消瘦、骨盆倾斜、骶尾部压痛和左侧4字试验阳性都不符合。NG12要求儿童持续或不明原因骨痛在48小时内查血常规，不明原因骨痛考虑48小时内拍X线；本病例记录的进一步检查是在九个月骨痛和四个月跛行之后。
teachingPoints.en: Red flags (NICE NG12, 2015, updated 2026): growing pains are a diagnosis of exclusion — evening or night pain in both legs, a normal examination and no limp. Nine months of pain in several places (knees, then back, ribs and hip), a four-month limp, weight loss, a pelvic tilt, sacrococcygeal tenderness and a positive left FABER test fit none of it. NG12 asks for a full blood count within 48 hours for persistent or unexplained bone pain in a child and considers an X-ray within 48 hours for unexplained bone pain; the further assessment recorded here came after nine months of pain and four of limping.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先取样后治疗（CCLG指引；Euro Histio Net儿童LCH指南，2013）：儿童多节段骨病变伴椎体扁平（本例T2、T10），鉴别包括LCH和其他组织细胞病、白血病和淋巴瘤、感染（含结核）和慢性非细菌性骨髓炎。白细胞7.8×10⁹/L、血小板324×10⁹/L不能排除白血病：看涂片，并在活检麻醉时同做骨髓。选最安全可达的病灶（本例右髂骨溶骨性病变）取活检，新鲜组织送细菌和分枝杆菌培养，固定组织做病理和免疫组化（CD1a、langerin、S100、CD68、CD163、因子XIIIa），并留组织做分子检测；取样前不用激素。
teachingPoints.en: Tissue before treatment (CCLG guidance; Euro Histio Net paediatric LCH guideline, 2013): bone lesions at several levels with vertebra plana (here T2 and T10) have a differential of LCH and other histiocytoses, leukaemia and lymphoma, infection including TB, and chronic non-bacterial osteomyelitis. White cells of 7.8 × 10⁹/L and platelets of 324 × 10⁹/L do not exclude leukaemia: look at a film and take a marrow under the biopsy anaesthetic. Biopsy the safest accessible lesion (here the osteolytic right iliac lesion) with fresh tissue for bacterial and mycobacterial culture, fixed tissue for histology and immunohistochemistry (CD1a, langerin, S100, CD68, CD163, factor XIIIa) and tissue kept for molecular tests — and no steroid before the samples.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 判读活检（WHO第5版，2022；组织细胞学会修订分类，2016）：泡沫样组织细胞CD68、AACT阳性，CD1a、S100阴性，指向黄色肉芽肿家族；LCH为CD1a、langerin阳性、S100多阳性，Rosai–Dorfman病S100阳性。ECD的典型影像是双下肢长骨对称性骨硬化，脊柱和骨盆的溶骨性病变在LCH中更常见，而本病例没有记录长骨影像——所以诊断要结合全身情况和分子检测，近20%的ECD合并LCH病灶。2011年的报告只记录了四个标记；今天还会加做CD163、因子XIIIa、langerin和BRAF V600E。
teachingPoints.en: Reading the biopsy (WHO 5th edition, 2022; Histiocyte Society revised classification, 2016): CD68- and AACT-positive foamy histiocytes that are CD1a- and S100-negative point to the xanthogranuloma family; LCH is CD1a- and langerin-positive and usually S100-positive, Rosai–Dorfman disease S100-positive. ECD's classic image is symmetric osteosclerosis of the leg long bones, lytic spinal and pelvic lesions are more typical of LCH, and this case records no long-bone imaging — so the diagnosis needs the whole picture and molecular tests, and nearly 20 % of ECD has LCH lesions too. The 2011 report recorded four markers; today CD163, factor XIIIa, langerin and BRAF V600E would be added.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分期与治疗（2020年ECD国际共识；FDA批准，2017和2022年）：所有患者查BRAF V600E（约一半阳性），阴性者查其他MAPK通路改变；基线做包括下肢的全身FDG PET-CT、脑和垂体增强MRI、心脏和内分泌评估；除少数症状轻微的单器官病变外，多数患者需要治疗。BRAF V600E阳性者用BRAF抑制剂（维莫非尼2017年获FDA批准用于成人ECD），其他患者可用MEK抑制剂（考比替尼2022年获批用于成人组织细胞肿瘤）或干扰素α等常规治疗；儿童用药属超说明书，由组织细胞病中心决定。本病例没有记录分子检测、分期或任何治疗。
teachingPoints.en: Staging and treatment (2020 international ECD consensus; FDA approvals, 2017 and 2022): test every patient for BRAF V600E (about half are positive) and for other MAPK-pathway changes when negative; stage at baseline with whole-body FDG PET-CT including the legs, contrast brain and pituitary MRI, and cardiac and endocrine assessment; most patients need treatment, apart from a minority with minimally symptomatic single-organ disease. BRAF-V600E-positive disease takes a BRAF inhibitor (vemurafenib, FDA-approved for adults with ECD in 2017), other disease a MEK inhibitor (cobimetinib, approved for adults with histiocytic neoplasms in 2022) or conventional therapy such as interferon-alpha; in a child these are off-label and decided at a histiocytosis centre. This case records no molecular test, staging or treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 与孩子和家长沟通（SPIKES，2000；美国儿科学会，2016）：11岁的孩子应按发育水平参与决策，在家长同意之外争取她本人的认同；SPIKES提供谈话的结构。家长拒绝进一步治疗（本例记录的结局）时，先了解原因，例如费用、怕药物副作用或对疗效的印象；给出准确的当前信息，不引用旧文献的悲观结论；保持随访和第二意见的通道，写明需要马上回来的症状；如果拒绝明显有益的治疗会使孩子面临严重伤害，与上级医生和伦理团队讨论。本例“不再治疗”不能用来衡量今天的疗效。
teachingPoints.en: Talking with the child and her parent (SPIKES, 2000; American Academy of Pediatrics, 2016): an 11-year-old takes part in decisions as her development allows, with her assent sought alongside the parent's permission, and SPIKES gives the conversation its structure. When a family declines further treatment — the outcome recorded here — explore why (cost, fear of side effects, what they have heard about results), give accurate current information rather than old reports' pessimism, keep follow-up and a second opinion open with written warning signs, and if refusing clearly beneficial treatment would expose the child to serious harm, involve senior colleagues and the ethics team. This report's ‘no further treatment’ is no measure of treatment today.
